problems.title: Windows computer running slowly
symptoms: Applications take a long time to open

diagnosis.question: Did the computer become slow suddenly?

check-recent-changes.instruction: Check whether a recent application installation or Windows update coincided with the slowdown.

check-resource-usage.instruction: Open Task Manager and inspect CPU, memory, and disk usage.

solutions: Close unnecessary applications.
Restart the computer if convenient and save your work first.
Uninstall only unwanted applications you recognize.
Check available storage space.
safety: Do not delete unfamiliar system files or disable security software to improve speed.

problems.title: Windows connected to Wi-Fi but no internet

diagnosis.question: Do other devices on the same Wi-Fi have internet access?

check-computer-connection.instruction: On the Windows computer, try another website and another browser if available.

check-router-connection.instruction: Check the router's internet indicator and whether the internet provider reports an outage.

solutions: Turn Wi-Fi off and on again.
Restart the router only if other users can tolerate a brief interruption.
Use Windows network diagnostics.
If only this computer is affected, check proxy settings and network adapter status.
safety: Do not factory-reset the router unless you know how to restore its configuration.

problems.title: Windows Update fails to install

diagnosis.question: Does Windows Update show an error code?

record-error-code.instruction: Write down the complete error code and search Microsoft Support for that exact code.

check-update-progress.instruction: Check whether the update is still progressing before restarting or interrupting the computer.

solutions: Restart Windows when no update is actively installing.
Check internet access and available disk space.
Run the Windows Update troubleshooter if available.
Use Microsoft's instructions for the exact error code.
safety: Do not force power off while Windows is actively installing an update unless the device is unresponsive and recovery guidance requires it.

problems.title: Windows system drive is almost full

diagnosis.question: Is the C drive nearly full in File Explorer?

inspect-storage.instruction: Open Settings, then System and Storage, to identify which categories use the most space.

check-specific-location.instruction: Check the drive and folder where the affected application saves files.

solutions: Empty the Recycle Bin after reviewing its contents.
Remove temporary files using Windows Storage settings.
Move personal files to storage you control.
Uninstall applications you no longer need.
safety: Do not manually delete files from Windows or Program Files folders.
Back up important files before moving or deleting them.

problems.title: Windows computer will not shut down

diagnosis.question: Is Windows showing an update or firmware installation screen?

wait-for-installation.instruction: Wait and follow the on-screen instructions while the update or firmware operation is in progress.

check-app-blocking-shutdown.instruction: Look for an application asking you to save work or preventing shutdown.

solutions: Save open documents and close applications.
Install pending Windows updates when appropriate.
If the issue repeats, check reliability history and recent driver changes.
safety: Avoid holding the power button during firmware updates or active system updates unless there is no safer recovery option.

problems.title: Windows displays a blue screen
symptoms: Windows restarts after a blue screen

diagnosis.question: Did the blue screen begin after installing new hardware or a driver?

review-recent-driver.instruction: Record the new hardware or driver and check the manufacturer's support instructions.

record-stop-code.instruction: Photograph or write down the exact stop code and any named file.

solutions: Disconnect recently added nonessential peripherals if safe.
Install appropriate updates from trusted manufacturer sources.
Use Windows recovery options if the computer cannot start normally.
safety: Back up data if Windows remains accessible.
Do not download random driver-fixer utilities.

problems.title: Bluetooth device will not connect to Windows

diagnosis.question: Is the Bluetooth accessory in pairing mode and not already connected to another device?

check-windows-bluetooth.instruction: Check that Bluetooth is enabled in Windows Settings and that the accessory is nearby.

enable-pairing-mode.instruction: Follow the accessory manufacturer's instructions to enter pairing mode and disconnect it from other devices if needed.

solutions: Turn Bluetooth off and on again.
Remove the old pairing and pair the accessory again.
Check the accessory battery.
Install Bluetooth drivers through Windows Update or the PC manufacturer.
safety: Only remove a pairing if you can pair the device again.

problems.title: Microphone not working in Windows

diagnosis.question: Does the microphone work in Windows sound settings?

check-app-permissions.instruction: Check the affected application's microphone permission and selected input device.

check-input-device.instruction: Open Windows sound settings and confirm the intended microphone is selected.

solutions: Unmute the microphone and check its physical connection.
Allow microphone access for the intended application.
Select the correct input device.
Update audio drivers from a trusted source if necessary.
safety: Do not grant microphone access to apps that do not need it.

problems.title: No sound from Windows speakers
symptoms: Volume appears normal but no sound is heard

diagnosis.question: Is sound playing through another output device, such as Bluetooth headphones?

select-correct-output.instruction: Open sound settings and select the intended speakers or headphones as the output device.

check-volume-mute.instruction: Check system volume, application volume, mute controls, and speaker connections.

solutions: Choose the correct audio output.
Disconnect an unintended Bluetooth audio device.
Run the Windows audio troubleshooter if available.
Check for appropriate audio driver updates.
safety: Do not open powered speakers or electrical equipment.

problems.title: Printer will not print from Windows

diagnosis.question: Does the printer show an error or offline status?

check-printer-status.instruction: Read the printer display and check paper, ink or toner, and connection indicators.

check-print-queue.instruction: Open the Windows print queue and check whether a job is paused or stuck.

solutions: Check the USB or Wi-Fi connection.
Confirm the intended printer is selected.
Clear a stuck print job if safe to do so.
Restart the printer and computer if no job is actively processing.
safety: Follow the printer manual when clearing jams; hot components may be present.

problems.title: A Windows application will not open
symptoms: Nothing happens after clicking the app
The app opens and immediately closes

diagnosis.question: Did the problem start immediately after an app update or installation?

review-app-change.instruction: Check the app's official release notes and support page for known problems with the recent change.

check-app-repair.instruction: Check whether Windows Settings offers a Repair option for this application.

solutions: Restart Windows.
Install updates from the app's official source.
Use the app's repair option if available.
Reinstall only after confirming important app data is backed up.
safety: Do not download replacement installers from untrusted websites.

problems.title: File Explorer stops responding

diagnosis.question: Does File Explorer freeze only when opening one particular folder?

inspect-specific-folder.instruction: Check whether the folder contains a very large number of files or files on an unavailable network drive.

restart-explorer.instruction: If safe, use Task Manager to restart Windows Explorer.

solutions: Wait briefly if a large folder is loading.
Disconnect unavailable network locations if appropriate.
Install Windows updates.
Check disk health if freezes recur.
safety: Back up important files before running disk repair tools.

problems.title: Keyboard not working in Windows

diagnosis.question: Does the keyboard work before Windows starts or on another device?

check-windows-settings.instruction: Check accessibility keyboard settings and whether the issue occurs in multiple applications.

check-keyboard-connection.instruction: Check the cable, USB port, wireless receiver, batteries, and keyboard power.

solutions: Reconnect the keyboard.
Try another USB port.
Replace or recharge batteries where applicable.
Restart Windows and check for driver updates.
safety: Do not spill liquids onto the keyboard or open a battery pack.

problems.title: Webcam not working on Windows
symptoms: Video calls show a black image

diagnosis.question: Can another application use the camera?

check-app-settings.instruction: Select the correct camera in the affected application's settings and close other apps using it.

check-camera-permission.instruction: Check Windows camera privacy permissions, any physical shutter, and the camera device status.

solutions: Close other applications using the camera.
Allow camera access for the intended app.
Check the physical privacy shutter.
Update the camera driver from the PC manufacturer if necessary.
safety: Grant camera permission only to trusted applications.

problems.title: Windows laptop battery drains quickly
symptoms: Laptop runtime is shorter than usual

diagnosis.question: Did battery life change suddenly?

check-recent-apps.instruction: Check recent software changes and whether an application is using unusually high power.

check-power-usage.instruction: Review Windows power usage and battery health information if available.

solutions: Reduce screen brightness when practical.
Use an appropriate power mode.
Close applications that are not needed.
Check battery health using the manufacturer's diagnostic utility.
safety: Stop using a battery that is swollen, leaking, unusually hot, or emitting an unusual smell; seek qualified service.

problems.title: Windows laptop overheating

diagnosis.question: Is the laptop hot even when only light tasks are running?

check-ventilation.instruction: Place the laptop on a hard, flat surface and check that air vents are unobstructed.

check-heavy-workload.instruction: Check Task Manager for applications using unusually high CPU or GPU resources.

solutions: Keep ventilation openings clear.
Close unnecessary high-load applications.
Install appropriate manufacturer updates.
Arrange service if overheating continues.
safety: Stop using the device if it smells burnt, emits smoke, or becomes dangerously hot.
Do not insert objects into cooling vents.

problems.title: Windows computer will not start
symptoms: Computer powers on but Windows does not load

diagnosis.question: Does the computer show any power lights or manufacturer logo?

check-startup-message.instruction: Record any error message and note whether Windows recovery options appear.

check-power-source.instruction: Check the outlet, charger or power cable, and external power indicators.

solutions: Disconnect nonessential external devices.
Use Windows recovery options according to Microsoft's instructions.
Seek qualified support if hardware failure is suspected.
safety: Do not open a power supply or laptop battery compartment unless the manufacturer explicitly provides safe user instructions.
Consider data recovery before resetting or reinstalling Windows.

problems.title: Windows Search does not find files
symptoms: Expected files are missing from search results

diagnosis.question: Can you find the file by browsing to its folder in File Explorer?

check-indexing.instruction: Check Windows indexing settings and whether the folder is included in indexed locations.

check-file-location.instruction: Search other likely folders and confirm the file has not been moved or deleted.

solutions: Allow indexing to finish.
Check search filters and file extensions.
Run the search troubleshooter if available.
Restore deleted files from a backup if necessary.
safety: Do not delete the search index database manually unless following official repair instructions.

problems.title: External drive not visible in Windows
symptoms: Drive does not appear in File Explorer

diagnosis.question: Does the drive appear in Disk Management?

inspect-disk-status.instruction: Read the drive's status carefully and do not initialize or format it if it contains important data.

check-usb-connection.instruction: Try a known-good USB port and cable, and check whether the drive receives power.

solutions: Try another compatible cable or port.
Check Device Manager for device errors.
Assign a drive letter only if the existing partition is healthy and the action is appropriate.
safety: Never format or initialize a drive containing needed data.
Stop repeated attempts if the drive clicks, disconnects repeatedly, or contains irreplaceable files.

problems.title: Windows says a file is in use and will not delete
symptoms: Windows reports that a file is open

diagnosis.question: Do you recognize the file and know that it is safe to remove?

close-file-users.instruction: Close applications that may be using the file and try again.

identify-file-first.instruction: Check the file path, name, and source before attempting to remove it.

solutions: Close the application using the file.
Restart Windows and try again if the file is known to be safe.
Check permissions for files you own.
safety: Do not force-delete unknown system files or files belonging to running applications.

problems.title: Windows date or time is incorrect
symptoms: Websites report certificate or time errors

diagnosis.question: Is the time wrong by approximately a whole number of hours?

check-time-zone.instruction: Open Date and Time settings and verify the selected time zone.

check-time-sync.instruction: Check automatic time settings and use the available synchronization option.

solutions: Enable automatic time if appropriate.
Select the correct time zone.
Synchronize the clock while connected to the internet.
safety: Do not install unknown clock-fixing utilities.

problems.title: USB device is not recognized by Windows
symptoms: Windows reports an unrecognized USB device

diagnosis.question: Does the device work in another USB port or computer?

check-original-port.instruction: Inspect the original port and check whether other devices work in it.

check-device-cable.instruction: Check the cable, device power, and manufacturer compatibility guidance.

solutions: Reconnect the device.
Try another known-good port or compatible cable.
Restart Windows.
Check Device Manager and trusted driver updates.
safety: Disconnect a USB device immediately if it becomes unusually hot or smells burnt.

problems.title: One Windows application cannot access the internet

diagnosis.question: Can the application access the internet when a VPN is disconnected, if you normally use one?

check-vpn-settings.instruction: Check whether the VPN or its network policy affects this application's connection.

check-app-network-settings.instruction: Check the application's own proxy, account, server, and network settings.

solutions: Check the service's status page.
Verify date and time settings.
Review firewall rules for the application.
Update the app from its official source.
safety: Do not disable the firewall permanently or bypass workplace security policies.

problems.title: ZIP archive will not open or extract

diagnosis.question: Did the archive finish downloading completely?

check-archive-integrity.instruction: Check the file size and try opening the archive with a trusted archive utility.

download-again.instruction: Download the archive again from the original trusted source.

solutions: Try Windows' built-in extraction feature.
Use a reputable archive utility.
Request a new copy if the archive is corrupt.
safety: Do not run executable files from an archive unless you trust the source and expected contents.

problems.title: Android phone charges slowly

diagnosis.question: Are you using a compatible charger and cable that previously charged this phone normally?

check-phone-temperature.instruction: Check whether the phone is hot or very cold, because temperature can reduce charging speed.

check-charger-cable.instruction: Try a compatible, known-good charger and cable from a reputable source.

solutions: Use a compatible charger and undamaged cable.
Avoid heavy gaming while charging.
Check for lint or debris without inserting metal objects into the port.
Restart the phone if charging behaviour remains abnormal.
safety: Stop charging if the phone or battery swells, smokes, smells unusual, or becomes dangerously hot.
Do not use damaged chargers or cables.

problems.title: Android phone battery drains quickly

diagnosis.question: Did battery drain begin after installing or updating an app?

check-recent-app.instruction: Check the recently installed or updated app's battery usage and behaviour.

check-battery-usage.instruction: Open Android battery settings and inspect which apps use the most power.

solutions: Reduce screen brightness when practical.
Restrict background activity for apps that do not need it.
Update apps and Android through official channels.
Restart the phone and observe whether the drain continues.
safety: Stop using a phone with a swollen or unusually hot battery and seek qualified service.

problems.title: Android phone becomes unusually hot

diagnosis.question: Is the phone hot while charging or performing a demanding task?

stop-heavy-use.instruction: Stop demanding tasks, unplug the charger if safe, and let the phone cool in a shaded, ventilated place.

check-background-activity.instruction: Check battery usage and recent app activity after the phone has cooled.

solutions: Remove a thick case temporarily if the manufacturer permits.
Avoid direct sunlight and demanding tasks while charging.
Install official updates.
Seek service if overheating recurs during light use.
safety: Do not put the phone in a refrigerator or freezer.
Stop using it if it swells, smokes, leaks, or becomes dangerously hot.

problems.title: Android phone will not turn on
symptoms: Phone does not respond to the power button

diagnosis.question: Does the phone show any charging icon, vibration, or sound?

check-display.instruction: Check whether the phone may be powered on with a failed or blank display.

check-charging.instruction: Use a compatible charger and cable, and allow time for a deeply discharged battery to respond.

solutions: Try a known-good compatible charger and cable.
Follow the manufacturer's forced-restart instructions for the exact model.
Seek service if there is still no response.
safety: Do not open the phone or puncture the battery.
Do not charge a swollen, wet, or physically damaged phone.

problems.title: An Android app keeps crashing

diagnosis.question: Does the problem happen with only one app?

repair-one-app.instruction: Check for an app update and review the app's official support information.

check-system-updates.instruction: Check Android system updates and whether storage is nearly full.

solutions: Restart the phone.
Update the app through the official app store.
Clear the app cache if the option is available.
Reinstall only after checking whether the app stores important local data.
safety: Clearing app data or reinstalling may erase local information; confirm backups first.

problems.title: Android phone storage is full

diagnosis.question: Does Android storage settings show that photos or videos use most of the space?

review-media-backup.instruction: Review large photos and videos and confirm whether safe backups exist before removing any.

review-app-storage.instruction: Check which apps and downloaded files occupy the most storage.

solutions: Remove unwanted downloads after reviewing them.
Use the phone's built-in storage manager.
Back up important media before deleting local copies.
Uninstall apps you no longer use.
safety: Do not delete unknown folders or app data without understanding the consequences.
Verify backups before deleting originals.

problems.title: Android mobile data is not working
symptoms: Phone has cellular signal but no internet
Apps cannot load using mobile data

diagnosis.question: Can the phone make calls or send messages, and is mobile data enabled?

check-data-plan.instruction: Check the data allowance, carrier account status, and whether the affected app is allowed to use mobile data.

check-network-signal.instruction: Check coverage, airplane mode, SIM status, and any carrier outage.

solutions: Toggle airplane mode off and on.
Restart the phone.
Check the preferred network mode and data limit settings.
Contact the carrier if account or network issues are suspected.
safety: Do not change unknown APN values; record existing settings before modifying them.

problems.title: Android phone will not connect to Wi-Fi

diagnosis.question: Can another device connect to the same Wi-Fi network?

check-phone-network-settings.instruction: Confirm the correct network and password, and check whether the phone is blocked by network access controls.

check-router.instruction: Check router power, internet status, and whether the network is visible to other devices.

solutions: Toggle Wi-Fi off and on.
Restart the phone and, if appropriate, the router.
Forget and rejoin the network if you know the password.
Reset network settings only after understanding that saved networks and related settings may be removed.
safety: Do not share the Wi-Fi password publicly.

problems.title: Android Bluetooth device will not pair
symptoms: Accessory does not appear in the device list

diagnosis.question: Is the accessory powered on, charged, and in pairing mode?

check-old-pairing.instruction: Check whether the accessory is connected to another phone or has a stale saved pairing.

enable-accessory-pairing.instruction: Follow the accessory's manual to enter pairing mode and charge it if needed.

solutions: Keep the devices close together.
Turn Bluetooth off and on.
Remove the old pairing and pair again if appropriate.
Check manufacturer compatibility guidance.
safety: Only reset the accessory if you understand what settings will be erased.

problems.title: Android app notifications are not arriving
symptoms: Messages appear only when opening the app

diagnosis.question: Are notifications enabled for the affected app in Android settings?

check-battery-background.instruction: Check battery optimization, background data, and the app's own notification settings.

enable-notifications.instruction: Enable the required notification categories for the app.

solutions: Enable notifications in system and app settings.
Check Do Not Disturb and notification channels.
Allow necessary background activity for trusted messaging apps.
Update the app.
safety: Avoid disabling all battery protections globally; change settings only for apps that need them.

problems.title: Android phone microphone not working

diagnosis.question: Does the microphone fail in every app or only one app?

check-system-microphone.instruction: Test with the built-in recorder or a supported diagnostic feature and inspect the microphone openings for obstruction.

check-app-permission.instruction: Check the affected app's microphone permission and its own input settings.

solutions: Remove accessories that may block the microphone.
Check app permissions.
Restart the phone.
Seek service if multiple apps fail after software checks.
safety: Do not insert pins or liquids into microphone openings.

problems.title: Android phone speaker has no sound

diagnosis.question: Is audio being routed to Bluetooth headphones or another output device?

select-phone-speaker.instruction: Disconnect the unintended Bluetooth device or select the intended audio output.

check-volume-mode.instruction: Check media volume, ringtone volume, silent mode, and Do Not Disturb.

solutions: Raise the correct volume slider.
Disconnect unwanted audio accessories.
Restart the phone.
Test more than one app to determine whether the problem is app-specific.
safety: Do not insert sharp objects into speaker openings.

problems.title: Android camera shows a black screen

diagnosis.question: Does the camera work in another trusted app?

check-camera-app.instruction: Check the original camera app's permissions, updates, and cache.

check-camera-access.instruction: Check the Android camera privacy toggle, permissions, and whether another app is using the camera.

solutions: Close apps that use the camera.
Restart the phone.
Install official system and app updates.
Seek service if both cameras fail across apps.
safety: Do not install unknown camera apps that request unnecessary permissions.

problems.title: Google Play Store download remains pending

diagnosis.question: Can the phone access websites and does it have enough free storage?

check-play-queue.instruction: Check whether other downloads are queued and whether Play Store updates are in progress.

check-network-storage.instruction: Restore internet access and free storage if necessary.

solutions: Check the Play Store download queue.
Restart the phone.
Check date and time settings.
Clear Play Store cache if the issue continues.
safety: Do not download app installation files from untrusted websites.

problems.title: Android app installation fails

diagnosis.question: Does the app store say that the app is incompatible with your device?

check-compatibility.instruction: Check the app's supported Android versions, device requirements, and region availability.

check-storage-install.instruction: Check available storage, network access, and whether the installation source is trusted.

solutions: Free storage if needed.
Update Android where supported.
Restart the phone and retry through the official store.
Contact the app developer if the store reports a persistent error.
safety: Avoid bypassing Android security protections to install an untrusted APK.

problems.title: Android phone keeps restarting
symptoms: Phone repeatedly returns to the startup logo

diagnosis.question: Did the restarting begin after installing an app or update?

review-recent-change.instruction: Identify the recent app or update and check official troubleshooting guidance.

check-power-storage.instruction: Check whether the phone overheats, has very low storage, or has a damaged power button.

solutions: Remove recently installed problematic apps if the phone remains usable.
Install official updates when stable.
Back up data if possible.
Seek service if the phone repeatedly boot-loops.
safety: Do not factory-reset before considering data backup and recovery options.

problems.title: Android touchscreen is unresponsive
symptoms: Only part of the screen responds

diagnosis.question: Is the screen physically cracked, wet, or visibly damaged?

protect-device.instruction: Stop using the damaged or wet device and follow the manufacturer's safety and service guidance.

check-screen-software.instruction: Remove accessories that may interfere with touch and follow the manufacturer's restart procedure.

solutions: Clean and dry the screen with an appropriate soft cloth.
Remove a problematic screen protector if safe.
Restart the phone using the model's instructions.
Seek repair if the touch failure persists.
safety: Do not press hard on cracked glass or attempt to open the phone.

problems.title: Android phone does not detect the SIM card

diagnosis.question: Did the phone recently fall, get wet, or have its SIM removed?

inspect-sim-safely.instruction: Power the phone off if the manual requires it, then inspect the SIM tray and card for obvious damage.

check-carrier-status.instruction: Check for carrier outages, account issues, or SIM activation problems.

solutions: Restart the phone.
Reseat the SIM according to the device manual.
Check whether the SIM works in a compatible device if safe and appropriate.
Contact the carrier for a replacement SIM if needed.
safety: Do not force the SIM tray or use a damaged SIM card.

problems.title: Android mobile hotspot will not connect other devices
symptoms: Other devices cannot join the hotspot

diagnosis.question: Can the phone itself access the internet using mobile data?

check-hotspot-settings.instruction: Check hotspot enablement, password, device limit, band compatibility, and carrier restrictions.

fix-mobile-data-first.instruction: Resolve the phone's mobile data connection before troubleshooting tethering.

solutions: Restart the hotspot and the connecting device.
Check the hotspot password and security settings.
Try a compatible hotspot band if available.
Check carrier tethering limits.
safety: Use a strong hotspot password and disable the hotspot when it is not needed.

problems.title: Android phone does not detect a memory card
symptoms: Card is missing from storage settings
Phone asks to format the card

diagnosis.question: Does the card contain files you need to keep?

protect-card-data.instruction: Do not format the card. Check it with a compatible reader or qualified recovery service.

check-card-compatibility.instruction: Check the phone's supported card types and maximum capacity.

solutions: Power off before removing the card if the manual recommends it.
Inspect the card and tray for visible damage.
Try a compatible reader to distinguish card and phone problems.
safety: Formatting erases data; never format a card containing files you need.

problems.title: Android screen brightness keeps changing

diagnosis.question: Is adaptive or automatic brightness enabled?

adjust-adaptive-brightness.instruction: Check the adaptive brightness setting and adjust it in the conditions where it changes.

check-power-and-heat.instruction: Check battery saver, device temperature, and any extra-dimming features.

solutions: Adjust adaptive brightness settings.
Check battery saver and extra dim options.
Let an overheated phone cool down.
Restart the phone if behaviour seems abnormal.
safety: Do not disable thermal protection features.

problems.title: Android app says permission is denied

diagnosis.question: Does the app genuinely need the requested permission for the feature you are using?

review-permission.instruction: Open Android app settings and grant only the permission needed for the feature.

deny-unneeded-permission.instruction: Keep the permission denied and check whether the app offers an alternative workflow.

solutions: Review the app's permission settings.
Grant permission only while using the app when that option is available.
Update the app if a permission bug is known.
safety: Do not grant sensitive permissions to an app you do not trust.

problems.title: Android voice assistant does not hear speech
symptoms: Assistant does not respond to speech

diagnosis.question: Does the phone's microphone work in a recording app?

check-assistant-settings.instruction: Check the assistant's microphone permission, language, activation settings, and internet access.

fix-microphone-first.instruction: Troubleshoot the phone microphone before changing assistant settings.

solutions: Enable the required microphone permission.
Check the assistant language and voice activation options.
Check internet connectivity if the feature requires it.
Update the assistant app.
safety: Review microphone privacy settings and disable voice activation if you do not want it.

problems.title: Android contacts are not syncing
symptoms: New contacts do not appear on other devices

diagnosis.question: Are the contacts saved to the account you expect to sync?

check-sync-status.instruction: Check account sync settings and the account's online contacts page.

identify-contact-account.instruction: Open the contact details and identify whether it is stored on the phone, SIM, or an online account.

solutions: Enable contacts sync for the intended account.
Check internet access and account sign-in status.
Wait for sync to complete.
Export or back up contacts before account changes.
safety: Do not remove an account or delete contacts before confirming a backup.

problems.title: Android app is missing from the Share menu
symptoms: An app does not appear when sharing content

diagnosis.question: Is the content type supported by the receiving app?

check-app-installation.instruction: Check whether the receiving app is installed, updated, and allowed to handle this content type.

use-supported-format.instruction: Try sharing a file or link type that the receiving app officially supports.

solutions: Update the receiving app.
Restart the phone if the share menu appears stuck.
Use the app's own import or open-file feature if available.
safety: Only share private files with the intended recipient and application.

problems.title: Android app uses too much mobile data

diagnosis.question: Does Android data usage show the app using significant background data?

limit-background-data.instruction: Review the app's background data and unrestricted data settings.

check-foreground-usage.instruction: Check whether video streaming, downloads, or automatic backups explain the usage.

solutions: Enable Data Saver if appropriate.
Restrict background data for apps that do not need it.
Reduce video quality and automatic downloads.
Set a mobile data warning or limit.
safety: Be aware that restricting background data may delay notifications or synchronization.

problems.title: Android phone calls will not connect

diagnosis.question: Can the phone show cellular signal and receive calls?

check-call-settings.instruction: Check call barring, SIM selection for dual-SIM devices, and carrier calling settings.

check-carrier-signal.instruction: Check coverage, airplane mode, SIM status, and carrier outage information.

solutions: Restart the phone.
Check the selected SIM for calls.
Check account status with the carrier.
Contact the carrier if service remains unavailable.
safety: If you need emergency assistance, use any available local emergency calling option or another working phone.

problems.title: Android SMS messages are not sending

diagnosis.question: Can you make a normal phone call using the same SIM?

check-sms-settings.instruction: Check the default SMS app, message centre settings where applicable, and carrier SMS service status.

check-network-service.instruction: Check signal, SIM status, airplane mode, and carrier service.

solutions: Restart the phone.
Check the recipient number and available balance or plan.
Update the messaging app.
Contact the carrier if SMS service remains unavailable.
safety: Do not share verification codes with anyone who contacts you unexpectedly.

problems.title: Android alarm does not ring

diagnosis.question: Does the alarm appear on screen when its scheduled time arrives?

check-alarm-sound.instruction: Check the alarm's selected sound, alarm volume, and any app-specific settings.

check-alarm-schedule.instruction: Verify the alarm time, selected days, AM/PM where applicable, and app permissions.

solutions: Choose an audible alarm sound.
Set alarm volume to a suitable level.
Test a new alarm a few minutes ahead.
Update the Clock app.
safety: Do not rely on an untested phone alarm as the sole alert for a critical event.

problems.title: Android phone vibration is not working

diagnosis.question: Is vibration enabled in sound and accessibility settings?

check-mode-specific-settings.instruction: Check ringtone, notification, alarm, and haptic settings separately.

enable-vibration.instruction: Enable the appropriate vibration settings for calls, notifications, or touch feedback.

solutions: Check Do Not Disturb and sound profile settings.
Restart the phone.
Install official updates.
Seek service if all vibration functions fail.
safety: Do not open the phone to inspect the vibration motor yourself.

problems.title: Photos are missing from Android Gallery
symptoms: Gallery shows fewer photos than expected

diagnosis.question: Are the missing photos visible in a file manager or cloud photo account?

check-gallery-index.instruction: Check album visibility, hidden folders, and whether the Gallery app needs time to refresh.

check-trash-and-backups.instruction: Check the photo app's trash or recently deleted area and any available backups.

solutions: Check hidden albums and filters.
Restart the phone and allow media scanning to complete.
Review recently deleted items.
Restore from a verified backup if necessary.
safety: Do not clear app storage or format a memory card before checking whether the originals are backed up.

problems.title: Android phone reports moisture in the charging port
symptoms: Charging is blocked by a moisture warning

diagnosis.question: Could the phone or charging port have been exposed to liquid or high humidity?

dry-device-safely.instruction: Disconnect the cable and follow the manufacturer's drying guidance; allow the port to dry naturally.

check-port-debris.instruction: Inspect the port visually without inserting tools and consult manufacturer guidance if the warning persists.

solutions: Disconnect the charger.
Allow the device to dry in a well-ventilated place.
Use wireless charging only if the model supports it and the device is otherwise safe and dry.
Seek service if the warning remains.
safety: Do not insert metal objects, use a hair dryer, apply heat, or force charging while moisture is suspected.

problems.title: Android phone does not ring for incoming calls

diagnosis.question: Is the phone in silent mode or Do Not Disturb mode?

review-sound-mode.instruction: Review sound profile and Do Not Disturb rules, including scheduled rules.

check-ringtone-settings.instruction: Check ringtone volume, selected ringtone, and blocked caller settings.

solutions: Raise ringtone volume.
Choose an audible ringtone.
Review Do Not Disturb schedules.
Restart the phone and test with a known caller.
safety: Do not disable important emergency alert settings without understanding the consequences.

problems.title: Android screen does not rotate automatically

diagnosis.question: Is Auto-rotate enabled in Quick Settings?

check-app-support.instruction: Check whether the current app or screen supports rotation.

enable-auto-rotate.instruction: Enable Auto-rotate and test with an app that supports landscape orientation.

solutions: Enable Auto-rotate.
Restart the phone.
Update the affected app and Android.
Seek service if orientation sensors appear to have failed.
safety: Do not install untrusted sensor-calibration apps.

problems.title: Android system update will not install
symptoms: Installation stops or reports an error

diagnosis.question: Does the phone have sufficient free storage and a stable internet connection?

record-update-error.instruction: Record the exact error message and check the phone manufacturer's support guidance.

free-storage-and-connect.instruction: Free space safely and connect to a stable network before trying again.

solutions: Charge the phone adequately.
Back up important data.
Restart and retry the official update.
Contact the manufacturer if the same error persists.
safety: Do not interrupt an active firmware installation or install unofficial firmware without understanding the risks.

problems.title: Android links open in the wrong app
symptoms: Links open in an unexpected app
Android asks which app to use repeatedly

diagnosis.question: Is the wrong app set as the default for the link type?

change-default-app.instruction: Review Default apps and the affected app's Open by default settings.

check-supported-links.instruction: Check whether the app supports that link domain or file type.

solutions: Set the preferred browser or app as the default.
Clear the wrong app's defaults if that option is available.
Update the affected apps.
safety: Do not open suspicious links simply to test app handling.

problems.title: Android voice typing is not working
symptoms: Speech is not converted to text

diagnosis.question: Does the keyboard have microphone permission and an internet connection if required?

check-language-settings.instruction: Check voice typing language, keyboard settings, and the selected speech service.

check-permission-and-network.instruction: Check microphone permission and internet access for services that require online recognition.

solutions: Enable the intended microphone permission.
Check keyboard and voice typing settings.
Select the correct language.
Update the keyboard app through the official store.
safety: Avoid granting microphone access to untrusted keyboard applications.

problems.title: Android Do Not Disturb keeps turning on

diagnosis.question: Is there a scheduled Do Not Disturb rule or automatic mode enabled?

review-schedules.instruction: Review scheduled rules, bedtime modes, driving modes, and calendar-related settings.

check-automation-apps.instruction: Review trusted automation apps or connected devices that may change the sound profile.

solutions: Disable unwanted schedules.
Check bedtime and driving modes.
Review recently installed automation apps.
safety: Keep essential emergency alerts enabled according to your needs and local settings.

problems.title: Websites will not open on Android

diagnosis.question: Do the same websites open in another browser or on another network?

check-original-browser.instruction: Check the original browser's settings, extensions if supported, cache, and content blockers.

check-network-and-site.instruction: Check mobile data or Wi-Fi connectivity and whether the website is available to other users.

solutions: Try another browser.
Check date and time.
Clear browser cache if appropriate.
Check VPN, private DNS, or content-filter settings if you use them.
safety: Do not bypass security warnings on websites that handle passwords or payments.

problems.title: Wi-Fi router has no internet connection

diagnosis.question: Do all devices connected to the router lack internet access?

check-provider-and-router.instruction: Check the provider's outage information and inspect router and modem status indicators.

troubleshoot-device.instruction: Troubleshoot the affected device because the router may be working normally.

solutions: Check cables and power connections.
Restart modem and router according to provider guidance.
Contact the internet provider if the connection does not return.
safety: Do not factory-reset the router unless you know the required setup credentials and configuration.

problems.title: Wi-Fi signal is weak in one room
symptoms: Internet is slow far from router

diagnosis.question: Does the connection improve when you move closer to the router?

improve-router-placement.instruction: Test router placement and identify walls, metal objects, and interference between the router and device.

check-internet-speed.instruction: Test a wired connection or another nearby device to distinguish Wi-Fi coverage from provider speed.

solutions: Place the router centrally and in an open, elevated location where practical.
Keep it away from large metal objects and sources of interference.
Use a suitable access point or mesh system if needed.
safety: Do not place networking equipment where it can overheat or get wet.

problems.title: Internet connection is unusually slow

diagnosis.question: Is internet slow on multiple devices using the same connection?

check-router-provider.instruction: Run a reputable speed test near the router and compare results with your subscribed plan and provider guidance.

check-one-device.instruction: Check the affected device's Wi-Fi signal, background downloads, VPN, and resource usage.

solutions: Pause large downloads and backups.
Restart networking equipment if appropriate.
Improve Wi-Fi signal.
Contact the provider if wired speeds remain far below expected levels.
safety: Use reputable speed-test services and avoid installing unknown network optimizers.

problems.title: Wi-Fi router keeps restarting

diagnosis.question: Does the router restart even when network usage is low?

check-power-and-heat.instruction: Check the correct power adapter, ventilation, and any visible overheating or damage.

check-load-and-firmware.instruction: Check device load, firmware updates, and logs if the router provides them.

solutions: Use the manufacturer's specified power adapter.
Improve ventilation.
Install firmware from the router manufacturer if recommended.
Contact the provider if the router is provider-managed.
safety: Do not use a damaged power adapter or open the router's power supply.

problems.title: A device keeps disconnecting from Wi-Fi

diagnosis.question: Do other devices remain connected while this device disconnects?

check-device-settings.instruction: Check the device's Wi-Fi driver or software, power-saving settings, and distance from the router.

check-router-stability.instruction: Check router stability, firmware, interference, and power supply.

solutions: Restart the affected device.
Update device software and appropriate network drivers.
Improve signal strength.
Forget and reconnect to the network if you know the password.
safety: Avoid changing advanced router security settings without recording the original configuration.

problems.title: A new device cannot connect to Wi-Fi
symptoms: Existing devices connect but a new device fails

diagnosis.question: Are you certain the Wi-Fi password is correct and the network is compatible with the device?

check-router-access-controls.instruction: Check router access controls, device limits, and security compatibility.

verify-password-band.instruction: Re-enter the password carefully and check whether the device supports the router's band and security mode.

solutions: Verify the exact network name and password.
Check whether the router has reached a device limit.
Use a compatible supported Wi-Fi band.
Restart the device and router if appropriate.
safety: Do not weaken Wi-Fi encryption to an obsolete security mode just to connect a device.

problems.title: Websites fail because of a DNS error
keywords: server IP address could not be found

diagnosis.question: Do other websites work on the same device and connection?

check-domain-specific-issue.instruction: Check whether the affected website is down or the domain name was typed correctly.

check-dns-and-network.instruction: Check connectivity and any VPN, proxy, private DNS, or filtering configuration.

solutions: Restart the browser and router if appropriate.
Check the configured DNS service status.
Use the operating system's standard network diagnostics.
Change DNS only if you understand the privacy and security implications.
safety: Do not enter passwords on a site reached through suspicious redirects.

problems.title: Router administration page will not open

diagnosis.question: Are you connected to the router's own network?

check-gateway-address.instruction: Find the default gateway address from the device's network details and use the router's documented address.

connect-to-router.instruction: Connect to the router's Wi-Fi or local network before opening its administration page.

solutions: Use the correct local gateway address.
Try a different browser.
Check whether the router uses a documented HTTPS address or mobile app.
Contact the network administrator if the router is managed by someone else.
safety: Do not expose router administration to the public internet or share its administrator password.

problems.title: Guest Wi-Fi connects but has no internet
symptoms: Guest device connects but cannot browse

diagnosis.question: Does the guest network require a sign-in or acceptance page?

complete-captive-portal.instruction: Open a browser and follow the legitimate network sign-in instructions.

check-guest-network-policy.instruction: Check with the network owner whether guest access is enabled and whether devices are restricted.

solutions: Complete the official sign-in page.
Reconnect to the guest network.
Ask the network administrator to check guest access and internet status.
safety: Do not submit sensitive information to an unexpected Wi-Fi login page.

problems.title: Video calls freeze or break up

diagnosis.question: Does the problem affect other devices or video-call services too?

check-connection-load.instruction: Check whether other devices are using the connection for large downloads or high-resolution streams.

check-call-device.instruction: Check the affected device's CPU usage, Wi-Fi signal, camera, and app updates.

solutions: Move closer to the router or use a stable wired connection.
Pause large downloads.
Close unnecessary applications.
Check the meeting service's status and recommended network requirements.
safety: Do not install unknown call-quality optimizer software.

problems.title: Internet stops working when VPN is enabled
symptoms: Websites stop loading after VPN connects

diagnosis.question: Does internet access return when you disconnect the VPN?

check-vpn-server-settings.instruction: Check VPN server status, protocol settings, and provider troubleshooting guidance.

check-normal-connection.instruction: Troubleshoot the underlying internet connection before focusing on the VPN.

solutions: Reconnect to the VPN.
Try another server provided by the same trusted VPN service.
Update the VPN app.
Contact the VPN provider if the issue persists.
safety: Do not disable a required work VPN or security control without authorization.

problems.title: Some websites work while others fail

diagnosis.question: Does the same website fail on another device or network?

check-website-status.instruction: Check the site's official status information and verify the exact address.

check-device-filtering.instruction: Check browser extensions, parental controls, DNS filtering, VPN, and security software settings.

solutions: Try another browser.
Check whether a content blocker or network filter is responsible.
Check DNS configuration if appropriate.
Wait if the website itself is experiencing an outage.
safety: Do not bypass organizational or parental restrictions without authorization.

problems.title: Forgot the Wi-Fi password
symptoms: A new device cannot join the network

diagnosis.question: Do you own or administer this network, or have permission from its owner?

recover-authorized-password.instruction: Check the router label, saved passwords on your own devices, or the router's authorized administration interface.

ask-network-owner.instruction: Ask the network owner or administrator to provide access.

solutions: Check the router label if the password was never changed.
View saved network credentials on a device you own using its normal settings.
Change the Wi-Fi password through the authorized router interface if necessary.
safety: Do not attempt to access a network without permission.
Changing the password disconnects devices that use the old password.

problems.title: Forgot the router administrator password
symptoms: Cannot sign in to router settings

diagnosis.question: Is this your router or do you have authorization to administer it?

check-password-records.instruction: Check your password manager, setup records, or provider documentation.

contact-owner.instruction: Ask the owner or network administrator to make the required change.

solutions: Use the provider's official account recovery procedure.
Use the documented reset procedure only if you can restore the network configuration.
safety: A factory reset can erase internet, Wi-Fi, and provider settings.
Do not reset equipment you do not administer.

problems.title: A website will not load in the browser

diagnosis.question: Does the website open in another browser or on another device?

check-original-browser.instruction: Check extensions, proxy settings, cached site data, and browser updates.

check-site-and-network.instruction: Check internet connectivity, the exact URL, and whether the website is experiencing an outage.

solutions: Reload the page.
Try a private window or another browser.
Temporarily disable a suspected extension for testing.
Clear site data only if you understand that you may be signed out.
safety: Do not ignore certificate or malware warnings just to load a page.

problems.title: Browser shows too many pop-ups

diagnosis.question: Do the notifications appear even when the website is closed?

review-site-notifications.instruction: Review browser site notification permissions and remove permission from sites you do not trust.

check-browser-extensions.instruction: Review installed extensions and remove ones you do not recognize or need.

solutions: Block unwanted pop-ups in browser settings.
Remove suspicious site notification permissions.
Uninstall unfamiliar extensions.
Run a scan using trusted security software if pop-ups persist.
safety: Do not click fake virus alerts or install software promoted by suspicious pop-ups.

problems.title: Browser pages load slowly
symptoms: Pages take a long time to open

diagnosis.question: Are pages slow in every browser or only one browser?

check-network-device.instruction: Check network speed, system resource usage, and whether the sites themselves are slow.

check-browser-extensions.instruction: Review extensions, open tabs, and browser resource usage.

solutions: Close unnecessary tabs.
Update the browser.
Disable unnecessary extensions one at a time for testing.
Clear cached files if appropriate.
safety: Export or back up important browser data before resetting the browser profile.

problems.title: Browser password autofill is not working

diagnosis.question: Is the password saved in the browser or password manager you intend to use?

check-autofill-settings.instruction: Check autofill settings, profile selection, and whether the site blocks or changes its login form.

check-password-vault.instruction: Check the intended password manager and whether you are using the correct profile or vault.

solutions: Enable the appropriate autofill feature.
Unlock the intended password manager.
Check whether the site address matches the saved login.
Update the browser or password manager.
safety: Never share saved passwords or master passwords with troubleshooting services.

problems.title: Browser download fails

diagnosis.question: Is there enough free space on the download drive?

check-network-and-browser.instruction: Check connection stability, browser download settings, and whether the server is still available.

free-download-space.instruction: Free disk space safely or choose a different trusted download location.

solutions: Retry from the official source.
Check the selected download folder and permissions.
Review security software alerts rather than bypassing them.
Try another browser if the source is trusted.
safety: Do not bypass a malware warning for an unknown download.

problems.title: Browser displays a security certificate warning
symptoms: Browser warns that a connection is not private

diagnosis.question: Is the computer or phone's date and time correct?

check-network-and-site.instruction: Check the exact domain, network sign-in requirements, and whether the website's certificate may have expired.

correct-device-time.instruction: Correct the device date, time, and time zone, then retry.

solutions: Correct device time if wrong.
Try a trusted network.
Check the website's official status or contact its administrator.
Wait for the site owner to fix a certificate problem.
safety: Do not proceed through certificate warnings on banking, email, shopping, or password sites.

problems.title: Browser bookmarks appear to be missing

diagnosis.question: Are you using the same browser profile as before?

check-bookmark-location.instruction: Check other bookmark folders, the bookmark manager, and whether the bookmark bar is hidden.

switch-profile.instruction: Open the correct existing browser profile and check whether synchronization is enabled.

solutions: Check the browser's bookmark manager.
Restore from a verified bookmark export if needed.
Check the correct profile and sync status.
Export bookmarks once they are recovered.
safety: Do not reset or delete browser profiles before backing up available bookmark data.

problems.title: A browser extension causes errors or broken pages
symptoms: Pages break after installing an extension
Browser behaves differently with extensions enabled

diagnosis.question: Did the issue start after installing or updating an extension?

disable-recent-extension.instruction: Disable the recently added or updated extension and reload the affected page.

test-clean-profile.instruction: Test in a clean browser profile or private window where extensions are disabled by default, if supported.

solutions: Disable extensions one at a time to identify the cause.
Update or remove the problematic extension.
Check extension permissions and developer reputation.
safety: Avoid extensions that request broad access to all websites without a clear need.

problems.title: Browser search engine changed unexpectedly
symptoms: New tabs or home page changed

diagnosis.question: Did the change occur after installing an extension or application?

review-recent-installations.instruction: Review recent extensions and applications and remove anything you do not recognize.

check-browser-settings.instruction: Check default search engine, home page, startup pages, and managed-browser notices.

solutions: Restore the intended search engine in browser settings.
Remove unwanted extensions.
Run a trusted security scan if settings keep changing.
Reset browser settings only after understanding what will be reset.
safety: Do not install a recommended cleanup tool from a suspicious pop-up.

problems.title: Browser blocks camera or microphone access
symptoms: Video call cannot use the camera

diagnosis.question: Has the browser been granted camera and microphone permission for this specific site?

check-system-permissions.instruction: Check operating-system privacy settings, selected devices, and whether another app is using them.

grant-site-permission.instruction: Open the browser's site information or permissions panel and allow only the required device access for the trusted site.

solutions: Select the correct camera and microphone.
Allow access for the intended website.
Reload the page after changing permission.
Close other apps using the device.
safety: Grant camera and microphone access only to websites you trust.

problems.title: Browser uses too much memory with many tabs
symptoms: Browser slows down with many tabs

diagnosis.question: Does performance improve when you close or suspend unused tabs?

reduce-tab-load.instruction: Identify tabs and web apps using the most memory and close those that are no longer needed.

check-extensions-and-device.instruction: Check extension usage and overall system memory pressure.

solutions: Close unused tabs.
Use built-in tab sleeping or memory saver features if available.
Remove unnecessary extensions.
Restart the browser after saving work.
safety: Save unsent forms and documents before closing tabs.

problems.title: Video will not play in the browser
symptoms: Playback reports an error or spins indefinitely

diagnosis.question: Does the video play in another browser or on another device?

check-original-browser.instruction: Check browser updates, extensions, site permissions, and hardware acceleration settings.

check-service-and-network.instruction: Check internet stability, the streaming service status, and whether the content is available in your region or account.

solutions: Update the browser.
Disable a suspected content-blocking extension for testing.
Check the service account and subscription if required.
Restart the browser.
safety: Do not install unofficial codecs or video players from suspicious websites.

problems.title: Cannot find a downloaded file
symptoms: Download appears complete but file cannot be found
File is not in the expected folder

diagnosis.question: Does the browser's download history show the completed file?

open-download-location.instruction: Use the browser's show-in-folder or open-containing-folder action if available.

check-download-status.instruction: Check whether the download failed, was blocked, or was saved to a different location.

solutions: Check the browser's configured download folder.
Search by filename in File Explorer.
Check whether security software quarantined the file.
Download again only from the trusted original source.
safety: Do not restore quarantined files unless you have verified they are safe.

problems.title: A website keeps logging you out

diagnosis.question: Does the browser delete cookies or site data when it closes?

review-cookie-settings.instruction: Check cookie settings, private browsing mode, and automatic data-clearing tools.

check-site-session.instruction: Check whether the service has session restrictions or an account security alert.

solutions: Allow necessary cookies for the trusted site.
Avoid private browsing if you need a persistent session.
Check device date and time.
Contact the website if sessions expire unexpectedly.
safety: Do not weaken cookie protections globally just to fix one site.

problems.title: Website displays the wrong language
symptoms: Website opens in an unexpected language

diagnosis.question: Is the browser translating the page automatically?

check-translation-settings.instruction: Review browser translation settings and turn off translation for this site if appropriate.

check-site-language.instruction: Check the website's language selector and browser preferred-language settings.

solutions: Choose the desired language on the website.
Adjust browser language preferences.
Review automatic translation settings.
safety: When translating legal, medical, or financial information, verify important details in an authoritative language version.

problems.title: Email messages will not send

diagnosis.question: Can you receive new email messages in the same account?

check-outgoing-settings.instruction: Check the outgoing server settings, attachment size, and any service error message.

check-account-and-network.instruction: Check internet access, account sign-in status, and the provider's service status.

solutions: Check the recipient address.
Remove or reduce an attachment that exceeds the provider's limit.
Reauthenticate the account if requested through the official app.
Check the provider's sending limits and service status.
safety: Do not email passwords, verification codes, or sensitive information without appropriate protection.

problems.title: Email messages are not arriving

diagnosis.question: Have you checked Spam, Junk, and other inbox categories?

check-filters-and-storage.instruction: Review filters, blocked senders, mailbox storage limits, and account sync status.

check-other-folders.instruction: Check Spam, Junk, Archive, Promotions, and any other inbox categories.

solutions: Check filters and blocked addresses.
Confirm the sender used the correct address.
Check mailbox storage and provider status.
Refresh or reauthenticate the mail app if appropriate.
safety: Do not mark suspicious messages as safe without checking their origin.

problems.title: Microphone does not work in a video-call app

diagnosis.question: Is the microphone muted in the meeting controls?

unmute-microphone.instruction: Unmute yourself if you intend to speak and have permission to do so.

check-selected-input.instruction: Select the intended microphone and check operating-system permissions.

solutions: Check the app's selected input device.
Allow microphone access.
Close other apps using the microphone.
Leave and rejoin the meeting if the app becomes stuck.
safety: Mute the microphone when you do not want others to hear nearby conversations.

problems.title: Camera does not work in a video-call app

diagnosis.question: Does the camera work in the operating system's camera app?

check-meeting-camera.instruction: Select the correct camera in the meeting app and check its permission.

fix-camera-first.instruction: Check camera privacy controls, physical shutter, and device status before troubleshooting the meeting app.

solutions: Close other apps using the camera.
Allow camera access for the meeting app.
Check the selected camera and physical shutter.
Update the app and device drivers through trusted sources.
safety: Grant camera access only to trusted applications and websites.

problems.title: PDF file will not open

diagnosis.question: Does the PDF open in another trusted PDF reader or browser?

check-original-reader.instruction: Update the original reader and check whether its settings or extensions affect PDF handling.

check-file-integrity.instruction: Check file size and obtain a fresh copy from the original trusted source if possible.

solutions: Try a trusted PDF reader.
Download the file again from its source.
Check whether the document requires a password.
Update the PDF reader.
safety: Do not enable active content or follow unexpected links inside an untrusted PDF.

problems.title: A file will not open because its format is unknown
symptoms: No application is associated with the file

diagnosis.question: Do you know which application created the file and trust its source?

identify-required-app.instruction: Check the file extension and the creator's recommended application.

verify-file-source.instruction: Verify who sent the file and why it was expected before opening it.

solutions: Install a suitable application from its official source.
Ask the sender to confirm the file format.
Check whether the file is incomplete or renamed incorrectly.
safety: Do not execute unknown files or enable macros in unexpected documents.

problems.title: USB device disconnects repeatedly

diagnosis.question: Does the issue stop when you use a different known-good cable or port?

replace-cable-or-port.instruction: Inspect the original cable and port for damage or looseness.

check-device-power.instruction: Check whether the device requires external power or a powered hub.

solutions: Use a compatible known-good cable.
Try a different port.
Avoid unpowered hubs for devices that need more power.
Update appropriate drivers if the problem persists.
safety: Disconnect a device immediately if it becomes hot, smells burnt, or shows electrical damage.

problems.title: External hard drive makes unusual clicking noises
symptoms: Drive makes repeated unusual clicking sounds
Drive disconnects or files become inaccessible

diagnosis.question: Does the drive contain important data that is not backed up?

protect-important-data.instruction: Stop unnecessary use and consider professional data recovery before further attempts.

check-manufacturer-guidance.instruction: Check the drive manufacturer's diagnostic guidance and warranty support.

solutions: Disconnect the drive safely if possible.
Avoid repeated power cycling and repair attempts.
Use a professional recovery service for irreplaceable data.
safety: Do not open the drive enclosure or run destructive repair tools on a failing drive containing needed data.

problems.title: Printer reports a paper jam
symptoms: Printer stops and displays a jam warning

diagnosis.question: Can you see paper stuck in an area that the printer manual identifies as user-accessible?

clear-accessible-jam.instruction: Follow the printer manual to remove accessible paper gently in the recommended direction.

check-manual-and-feed.instruction: Check the manual's jam locations and paper-loading guidance.

solutions: Remove paper according to the manual.
Use correctly sized, undamaged paper.
Adjust paper guides.
Check for small torn pieces only in user-accessible areas.
safety: Turn off and unplug the printer when the manual requires it.
Avoid hot fuser components and do not force internal parts.

problems.title: Printer produces blank pages
symptoms: Print preview contains content but output does not

diagnosis.question: Does the printer's own test page also come out blank?

check-ink-toner.instruction: Check ink or toner status and follow the manufacturer's maintenance procedure.

check-document-and-driver.instruction: Check the document, print preview, selected pages, and printer driver settings.

solutions: Check ink or toner levels.
Run the recommended printhead or nozzle check if applicable.
Verify the document contains visible content.
Update the official printer driver if needed.
safety: Handle toner and ink according to manufacturer instructions; do not inhale toner dust.

problems.title: Printer colours look wrong

diagnosis.question: Does the printer's test page also show incorrect or missing colours?

check-consumables-and-head.instruction: Check consumables and run the manufacturer's recommended print quality test.

check-document-colour-settings.instruction: Check document colour settings, selected paper type, and colour management options.

solutions: Check ink or toner levels.
Run the appropriate maintenance utility.
Select the correct paper type and colour mode.
Use a suitable colour profile when required.
safety: Avoid excessive printhead cleaning cycles because they can consume ink.

problems.title: Television has sound but no picture
symptoms: Audio is audible but screen appears black

diagnosis.question: Does the TV menu appear when you press the remote's menu button?

check-input-source.instruction: Check the selected input, connected device, cable, and source output.

check-safe-power-reset.instruction: Follow the TV manufacturer's safe restart guidance and check for a standby indicator.

solutions: Select the correct input.
Check the external device and HDMI cable.
Restart the TV according to the manual.
Seek qualified service if the menu itself never appears.
safety: Do not open the television; internal components may retain dangerous voltages.

problems.title: Television has no sound
symptoms: Picture works but no sound is heard

diagnosis.question: Is the TV sound routed to an external soundbar or Bluetooth device?

check-external-audio.instruction: Check the external device's power, selected input, and connection.

check-tv-audio-settings.instruction: Check mute, volume, audio output settings, and whether other TV sources have sound.

solutions: Unmute the TV.
Select the intended audio output.
Check HDMI or optical connections.
Restart the TV and external audio device if appropriate.
safety: Do not open the television or soundbar to inspect internal electrical parts.

problems.title: Television displays no signal

diagnosis.question: Is the correct HDMI or TV input selected?

check-source-device.instruction: Check that the set-top box, console, or other source device is powered on and outputting a signal.

select-correct-input.instruction: Select the HDMI port or broadcast input used by the connected device.

solutions: Check the selected input.
Reconnect the HDMI cable with devices safely powered down if the manual recommends it.
Try a known-good compatible cable or input.
Check the source device and service status.
safety: Do not force connectors or open electronic equipment.

problems.title: Television remote control is not working
symptoms: Buttons do not control the TV

diagnosis.question: Does the TV respond to its physical buttons or a manufacturer-approved phone app?

check-remote.instruction: Check remote batteries, battery orientation, pairing, and whether the remote is blocked or damaged.

check-tv-power.instruction: Check the TV's power indicator and safe external power connections.

solutions: Replace weak batteries with the correct type.
Re-pair the remote if required.
Clean the outside of the remote and inspect for stuck buttons.
Use the manual's reset procedure if applicable.
safety: Keep button batteries away from children and dispose of them safely.

problems.title: Smart TV apps will not open
symptoms: App remains stuck on its loading screen

diagnosis.question: Can the TV access other internet-connected apps or services?

check-one-app.instruction: Check the affected app's service status, updates, and account sign-in.

check-tv-network.instruction: Check the TV's network connection and whether other devices can access the internet.

solutions: Restart the app and TV.
Update the app and TV software through official settings.
Check available TV storage if supported.
Reinstall the app only if account details and settings are known.
safety: A factory reset can remove accounts and settings; use it only after other steps and after checking the manual.

problems.title: Bluetooth headphones connect but produce no sound
symptoms: Headphones show connected but audio comes from speakers

diagnosis.question: Are the headphones selected as the active audio output?

check-headphone-volume.instruction: Check headphone volume, mute status, battery, and whether the correct audio profile is active.

select-headphones.instruction: Choose the headphones as the audio output in the device's sound settings.

solutions: Select the headphones as the output device.
Raise volume on both devices.
Disconnect and reconnect the headphones.
Remove and recreate the pairing if necessary.
safety: Keep listening volume at a safe level.

problems.title: Bluetooth headphone audio keeps cutting out

diagnosis.question: Does the problem improve when the headphones are close to the connected device?

check-distance-interference.instruction: Reduce distance and obstacles, and test away from sources of wireless interference.

check-battery-and-pairing.instruction: Charge the headphones and check whether the issue occurs with another compatible device.

solutions: Keep devices within the recommended range.
Charge the headphones.
Disconnect unused Bluetooth devices.
Update firmware through the manufacturer's official app if available.
safety: Do not use damaged batteries or unofficial firmware tools.

problems.title: Bluetooth speaker will not pair
symptoms: Speaker is not visible in Bluetooth settings

diagnosis.question: Is the speaker charged and in pairing mode?

check-existing-connections.instruction: Check whether the speaker is already connected to another device and whether its pairing list is full.

enable-speaker-pairing.instruction: Charge the speaker and follow the manufacturer's pairing instructions.

solutions: Move the devices close together.
Disconnect the speaker from other devices.
Remove stale pairings and retry.
Use the documented reset procedure if needed.
safety: Do not reset the speaker unless you understand what settings will be erased.

problems.title: HDMI-connected device has no picture

diagnosis.question: Is the display set to the HDMI input used by the source device?

check-source-and-cable.instruction: Check source power, HDMI cable seating, and whether another compatible cable or port works.

select-hdmi-input.instruction: Select the correct HDMI input on the TV or monitor.

solutions: Select the correct input.
Reconnect the cable safely.
Restart the source device and display.
Check resolution compatibility and device documentation.
safety: Do not force HDMI connectors or open the display.

problems.title: Computer monitor flickers

diagnosis.question: Does the flicker occur with another compatible cable or device?

check-monitor-settings.instruction: Check the monitor's supported resolution and refresh rate, and install appropriate graphics updates.

check-original-connection.instruction: Check the cable, connector seating, and original computer's graphics settings.

solutions: Reseat or replace a suspect compatible cable.
Use a supported refresh rate.
Update graphics drivers from the device manufacturer.
Test the monitor with another compatible source.
safety: Do not open the monitor; internal components may retain dangerous voltages.

problems.title: Phone charger or cable becomes unusually hot
symptoms: Cable or connector smells unusual or changes colour

diagnosis.question: Is the charger, cable, or connector damaged, discoloured, smoking, or too hot to handle comfortably?

stop-using-charger.instruction: Stop charging and disconnect power only if it is safe to do so; replace the damaged equipment with a compatible reputable product.

check-normal-heat.instruction: Check the manufacturer's guidance on normal operating temperature and ensure the charger has ventilation.

solutions: Use a compatible charger from a reputable source.
Keep the charger uncovered and ventilated.
Replace damaged cables and adapters.
Seek service if unusual heating persists.
safety: Stop using equipment that smokes, sparks, smells burnt, or has damaged insulation.
Never open a mains-powered charger.

problems.title: Washing machine will not start

diagnosis.question: Is the display or any indicator light on?

check-cycle-and-door.instruction: Check that the door or lid is fully closed and a valid cycle has been selected.

check-power-safely.instruction: Check the wall switch and visible power connection without opening electrical parts.

solutions: Check child lock and delay-start settings.
Ensure the door or lid is closed correctly.
Follow the manual's safe reset procedure.
Contact qualified service if power is present but the machine remains unresponsive.
safety: Do not bypass the door lock or open electrical panels.
Do not touch plugs or switches with wet hands.

problems.title: Washing machine will not drain water

diagnosis.question: Does the machine display a drain error code?

check-manual-error-code.instruction: Look up the exact code in the manufacturer's manual.

check-drain-hose.instruction: Inspect the externally visible drain hose for kinks or obvious blockage without moving a heavy machine unsafely.

solutions: Check the drain hose position and visible kinks.
Use the manual's procedure for accessible filter cleaning if provided.
Arrange service if the pump or internal drain path may be blocked.
safety: Disconnect power before user-maintenance steps when the manual requires it.
Water may be hot; prepare for spills and never force open a locked door.

problems.title: Washing machine vibrates excessively

diagnosis.question: Does the vibration happen mainly during the spin cycle or with one heavy item?

rebalance-load.instruction: Pause the cycle if safe and redistribute the load according to the manual.

check-machine-level.instruction: Check whether the machine is level and all feet are stable, following the installation instructions.

solutions: Redistribute the laundry.
Avoid overloading or washing one bulky item alone if the manual advises against it.
Check the machine's level and installation.
Arrange service if severe vibration persists.
safety: Do not reach into a moving drum or attempt to hold a vibrating machine in place.

problems.title: Refrigerator is not cooling properly
symptoms: Food is spoiling sooner than expected

diagnosis.question: Is the refrigerator receiving power and are the doors closing fully?

check-settings-airflow.instruction: Check temperature settings, blocked air vents, door seals, and whether the unit has enough ventilation.

check-power-door.instruction: Check visible power status and ensure the doors are not obstructed.

solutions: Set temperatures according to the manufacturer's guidance.
Keep internal vents clear.
Check door seals and avoid prolonged door opening.
Contact service if cooling does not recover.
safety: Keep perishable food at safe temperatures and discard food that may have been held unsafely.
Do not open sealed refrigeration systems or handle refrigerants.

problems.title: Refrigerator makes an unusual noise

diagnosis.question: Is the noise accompanied by burning smell, smoke, or loss of cooling?

stop-and-seek-service.instruction: Stop using the appliance if there are electrical danger signs and seek qualified service.

check-placement.instruction: Check whether the refrigerator is stable and external items are rattling against it.
