solutions: Remove objects resting on the refrigerator.
Check level and clearance according to the manual.
Allow normal compressor and fan sounds to be distinguished from new unusual noises.
Seek service if the noise persists or cooling changes.
safety: Do not remove internal panels or touch exposed electrical parts.

problems.title: Air conditioner is running but not cooling
symptoms: Airflow is present but not cool

diagnosis.question: Is the AC set to cooling mode at a suitable temperature?

check-airflow-filter.instruction: Check accessible air filters, blocked vents, and whether the outdoor unit has unobstructed airflow.

select-cooling-mode.instruction: Select the manufacturer's cooling mode and a suitable target temperature.

solutions: Clean user-accessible filters according to the manual.
Keep supply and return vents unobstructed.
Close windows and doors while cooling.
Contact qualified HVAC service if cooling remains poor.
safety: Do not open electrical compartments or handle refrigerants.
Turn off the unit if there is a burning smell or electrical hazard.

problems.title: Air conditioner is leaking water indoors
symptoms: Wall or floor near AC becomes wet

diagnosis.question: Is water near electrical outlets, wiring, or the appliance's electrical components?

stop-unit-safely.instruction: Stop using the unit if safe and keep people away from wet electrical areas; arrange qualified service.

check-visible-drain-and-filter.instruction: Check accessible filters and visible drain hose routing only as described in the manual.

solutions: Turn off the AC if leaking continues.
Clean accessible filters according to the manual.
Arrange service to inspect the condensate drain and installation.
safety: Do not touch wet electrical equipment or open the AC electrical compartment.

problems.title: Microwave runs but does not heat food
symptoms: Turntable or light works but food remains cold
Heating is much weaker than usual

diagnosis.question: Is the microwave door closing correctly and is a suitable cooking time and power level selected?

stop-and-service.instruction: Stop using the microwave and arrange qualified service if it runs without heating.

check-door-and-settings.instruction: Check the selected mode, power level, timer, and visible door closure without forcing the door.

solutions: Confirm the correct cooking mode and power level.
Use microwave-safe cookware and follow the manual.
Arrange qualified repair if heating remains absent.
safety: Never remove the microwave casing; dangerous high voltage can remain even when unplugged.
Do not operate a microwave with a damaged door or seal.

problems.title: Electric kettle will not heat water

diagnosis.question: Is the kettle correctly seated on its base and is the power indicator on?

check-water-and-auto-shutoff.instruction: Check water level and whether the kettle's overheat protection may have activated, following the manual.

check-safe-power-connection.instruction: Check the external plug and outlet visually; do not touch them if wet or damaged.

solutions: Fill within the marked minimum and maximum levels.
Allow the kettle to cool if its safety cutout activated.
Clean scale according to the manual.
Replace or service a faulty kettle.
safety: Do not operate an empty kettle.
Stop using it if the cord, plug, or base is damaged or smells burnt.

problems.title: Ceiling fan will not start
symptoms: Fan hums but blades do not move

diagnosis.question: Is there a burning smell, unusual heat, sparking, or a buzzing electrical sound?

switch-off-and-call-electrician.instruction: Turn off the fan at the safe control point if possible and arrange qualified electrical service.

check-control-and-power.instruction: Check the normal wall control, remote batteries, and circuit status without opening electrical fittings.

solutions: Check the normal wall switch and remote settings.
Replace remote batteries if applicable.
Arrange qualified service if the fan still does not start.
safety: Never push the blades while power is connected.
Do not open the ceiling fan or electrical wiring; use a qualified electrician.

problems.title: Water purifier dispenses water very slowly
symptoms: Water output is weaker than usual
Storage tank takes longer to fill

diagnosis.question: Is the incoming water supply normal and is the purifier showing a service or filter warning?

check-filter-maintenance.instruction: Check the purifier's maintenance indicator and filter replacement schedule.

check-inlet-supply.instruction: Check the external water supply valve and visible inlet hose according to the installation manual.

solutions: Check the water supply and user-accessible valve positions.
Replace filters only according to the manufacturer's schedule and procedure.
Arrange service if flow remains low.
safety: Do not drink water if the purifier reports a safety fault or water quality is uncertain.
Do not open pressurized components unless the manual identifies them as user-serviceable.

problems.title: Induction cooktop does not heat the pan
symptoms: Cooktop switches on but does not heat

diagnosis.question: Is the pan suitable for induction cooking and centred on the cooking zone?

check-power-and-error.instruction: Check the cooktop display for an error code and consult the manufacturer's manual.

use-compatible-pan.instruction: Use a flat-bottomed, induction-compatible pan of the size recommended by the manual.

solutions: Use compatible cookware.
Centre the pan on the cooking zone.
Check child lock and power settings.
Arrange service if the cooktop reports a persistent fault.
safety: Do not use a cooktop with a cracked surface.
Keep liquids away from electrical controls and follow the manual.

problems.title: Gas stove burner will not light
symptoms: Burner clicks but does not ignite

diagnosis.question: Can you smell gas when the burner fails to light?

stop-and-follow-gas-safety.instruction: Stop using the stove, avoid flames and electrical switches, leave the area if gas smell persists, and contact the gas supplier or emergency service from a safe location.

check-user-cleaning-guidance.instruction: Only after the stove is cool and gas is off as directed by the manual, check whether removable burner parts are correctly seated and dry.

solutions: Follow the stove manufacturer's user-maintenance instructions.
Ensure removable burner parts are dry and correctly seated.
Arrange qualified service if ignition remains unreliable.
safety: If you smell gas, do not keep trying to ignite the burner.
Do not disassemble gas valves or repair gas lines yourself.

problems.title: Doorbell does not ring
symptoms: Pressing the button produces no sound

diagnosis.question: Is it a battery-powered wireless doorbell or a wired doorbell?

check-wireless-battery.instruction: Check the button and receiver batteries and pairing instructions.

check-wired-indicators.instruction: Check the normal breaker status and visible indicator only; do not open the wired unit.

solutions: Replace batteries with the specified type.
Re-pair the wireless button and receiver if applicable.
Check the manufacturer's troubleshooting guide.
Arrange qualified service for a wired doorbell fault.
safety: Do not touch exposed wiring or open mains-connected chime equipment.

problems.title: Power strip or extension board has no power
symptoms: Connected devices do not receive power

diagnosis.question: Is there any burning smell, melted plastic, sparking, or visible damage?

stop-using-power-strip.instruction: Stop using the power strip and disconnect it only if safe; replace it or arrange qualified inspection.

check-safe-external-power.instruction: Check the wall outlet and power strip switch visually without opening the equipment.

solutions: Check the normal switch and wall outlet using a safe, known-good device if appropriate.
Reset overload protection only if the manufacturer's instructions allow it.
Replace a faulty or worn power strip.
safety: Do not open the power strip or overload it.
Never touch plugs or outlets with wet hands.

problems.title: Smart speaker does not respond to voice commands

diagnosis.question: Is the speaker powered on and connected to the expected Wi-Fi network?

check-microphone-and-account.instruction: Check the microphone mute control, account status, service status, and wake-word settings.

restore-power-and-wifi.instruction: Restore power and reconnect through the manufacturer's official app if necessary.

solutions: Check the microphone mute switch.
Check Wi-Fi connectivity.
Restart the speaker.
Update settings through the official app and check service status.
safety: Review the device's privacy and microphone settings.

problems.title: Smart TV repeatedly disconnects from Wi-Fi
symptoms: Streaming stops because the TV goes offline

diagnosis.question: Do other devices remain connected to Wi-Fi when the TV disconnects?

check-tv-network-settings.instruction: Check TV software, saved network settings, signal strength, and power-saving behaviour.

check-router.instruction: Check router stability, Wi-Fi coverage, and provider service.

solutions: Improve Wi-Fi signal near the TV.
Restart the TV and router when convenient.
Install official TV firmware updates.
Use wired Ethernet if supported and practical.
safety: Do not factory-reset the TV before checking saved account details and settings.

problems.title: Water tap has low water pressure
symptoms: Water flow is weaker than usual
Only one tap has low flow

diagnosis.question: Is the low pressure affecting all taps or only one tap?

check-building-supply.instruction: Check whether neighbours or other fixtures are affected and whether there is a known supply interruption.

check-tap-aerator.instruction: Inspect the tap outlet for visible blockage and follow the fixture manufacturer's safe cleaning instructions.

solutions: Check whether the local water supply is interrupted.
Clean a removable aerator only if you can do so safely.
Contact the building manager or a qualified plumber if the problem persists.
safety: Do not dismantle pressurized plumbing or work near electrical equipment in wet areas.

problems.title: Sink or washbasin drains slowly

diagnosis.question: Is the blockage limited to one sink, or are multiple drains affected?

check-main-drain.instruction: If multiple drains are affected, stop using excessive water and contact a qualified plumber or building maintenance.

check-local-blockage.instruction: Check the visible drain cover for removable hair or debris and follow the fixture instructions.

solutions: Remove visible debris from a safe, accessible drain cover.
Use a suitable plunger if appropriate for the fixture.
Contact a plumber if the blockage persists.
safety: Never mix drain-cleaning chemicals.
Avoid chemical drain cleaners if another chemical has already been used.

problems.title: A household light does not turn on

diagnosis.question: Are there sparks, a burning smell, buzzing, or signs of heat at the switch or fixture?

turn-off-and-call-electrician.instruction: Stop using the circuit and contact a qualified electrician; do not touch exposed wiring.

check-bulb-safely.instruction: Turn the light off and allow it to cool before checking a user-replaceable bulb according to the fixture instructions.

solutions: Replace a failed bulb with the correct type only when safe and permitted.
Check the normal wall switch.
Arrange qualified service if the fixture or circuit remains faulty.
safety: Never work on live wiring.
Do not remove fixture covers or electrical panels unless qualified.

problems.title: An appliance or electronic device smells burnt
symptoms: Burning smell comes from a device

diagnosis.question: Is there smoke, sparking, flame, or immediate danger?

move-away-and-call-emergency.instruction: Move people away, avoid touching the device, and contact local emergency services from a safe location if needed.

stop-using-device.instruction: Stop using the device and disconnect power only if it is safe to do so; arrange qualified inspection.

solutions: Keep people away from the device.
Replace or professionally repair faulty equipment.
Do not resume use until the cause has been resolved.
safety: Do not pour water onto electrical equipment.
If there is a fire or immediate danger, leave the area and contact local emergency services.

problems.title: An electronic device gets wet
symptoms: Device has been exposed to liquid
Device behaves abnormally after getting wet

diagnosis.question: Is the device connected to power, smoking, unusually hot, or showing electrical damage?

avoid-contact-and-seek-help.instruction: Keep away from the device if there is electrical danger and seek qualified assistance.

power-down-safely.instruction: If safe, disconnect external power and switch the device off according to its design and manufacturer guidance.

solutions: Remove external accessories if safe.
Follow the manufacturer's liquid-exposure guidance.
Arrange professional inspection if liquid entered the device.
safety: Do not charge a wet device.
Do not use an oven, hair dryer, or other heat source to dry electronics.
Do not open mains-powered equipment.
